author_or_account: UNDP in Asia and the Pacific
title: Youth influence in climate policy
discussion_signal: The post identifies a gap between youth capacity-building and actual decision-making power, and describes efforts to institutionalize youth engagement in climate governance. This makes agency a question of durable institutional voice rather than invitation or consultation alone.
linked_research_question: When young people are invited into climate governance, what converts participation into durable decision-making power?
limits: No independent account of youth participants’ experiences
The post does not show whether engagement changed policy outcomes
